name: donat
description: How to build an application on donat: migrations, tracked tables, per-role permissions, validators, rules, commands, durable processes, connectors, multitenancy, and the REST/MCP surfaces generated from them.

interface.shortDescription: Build declarative applications on the donat engine
interface.longDescription: Patterns for declaring an application on donat: SQL migrations for what binds every writer, YAML metadata for per-role permissions, validators, rules, transactional commands, durable processes and connector contracts, tenant isolation compiled into every surface, plus the GraphQL, REST and MCP surfaces generated from them.
defaultPrompt: Add a table with per-role permissions to this donat app.
Review this metadata directory for permission holes.
